result.other_findings: 61 patients in total, 27 did not need monitoring. Over 50% not monitored, attributed to unclear instructions from psychiatrists to GPs, patients and care coordinators.

result.setting: Hazel and Willow acute inpatient wards, Campbell Centre, Milton Keynes (Central and North West NHS Foundation Trust)
result.standard: Patients advised to inform DVLA of their mental health status; expected level 50%

cycle1.result: DVLA advised: Willow 7%, Hazel 0%. DVLA informed: Willow 0%, Hazel 0%.

result.intervention: First audit results presented at the general MDT with recommendations.

cycle2.result: DVLA advised: Willow 27%, Hazel 21%. DVLA informed: Willow 5%, Hazel 0%.

result.other_findings: Improvement remained below the expected 50% level; further re-audits were planned.

result.setting: Subacute stroke rehabilitation unit, Royal Hospital Donnybrook, Dublin
result.standard: National Clinical Guideline for Stroke (2023): high-intensity therapy, total of 3 hours daily, and improved reporting of exercise prescription

cycle1.result: Average recorded repetitions per week 77.9 (range 0–288).

result.intervention: Stroke exercise class restructured into a twice-weekly circuit class (5 x 6-minute stations) with outdoor mobility, tally counters, more semi-supervised practice and a 'champions board'.

cycle2.result: Average recorded repetitions per week 1,043 (range 245–2095); average 462 repetitions in the exercise class.

result.other_findings: Recording of repetitions improved each year; results may have been affected by staffing and COVID-19 restrictions.

result.topic: Postoperative pneumonia diagnosis and antibiotic choice
result.setting: Regional oesophagogastric cancer surgery centre, University College Hospital London
result.standard: US CDC criteria for pneumonia diagnosis and NICE guidelines for antibiotic choice

cycle1.result: 30.2% treated with antibiotics for pneumonia; 42.4% of these had sputum taken at suspicion; 69.7% prescribed a NICE-approved antibiotic; 17.4% met CDC pneumonia criteria.

result.other_findings: CDC-defined pneumonia was associated with longer ICU (10.6 vs 5.3 days) and hospital stay (29.4 vs 14.3 days); cultures were often taken after antibiotics were started.

result.setting: Tertiary upper gastrointestinal surgery unit, Royal Preston Hospital
result.standard: NICE and BSG recommendations against prophylactic antibiotics in acute pancreatitis

cycle1.result: Antibiotics prescribed in 45.9% (n=17/37); inappropriate prescribing 52.9% (n=9/17).

result.intervention: Awareness posters after the first cycle, then targeted teaching in weekly junior doctor sessions after the second cycle.

cycle2.result: Antibiotics prescribed in 47.8% (n=11/23); inappropriate prescribing 9.1% (n=1/11) (p for trend = 0.016); documentation of indication 100%.

result.other_findings: Three cycles: second cycle (August 2025, n=27) had antibiotics in 37% (n=10/27) with 30% (n=3/10) inappropriate. Mean antibiotic duration in the final cycle was 5.3 days.

result.topic: DNACPR and ceilings of care documentation
result.setting: Adult medical inpatients, Sligo University Hospital (Model 3 hospital)
result.standard: National HSE guidelines on DNAR and ceilings of care documentation

cycle1.result: DNAR status in medical notes 35%; reasoning 32%; patient discussion documented 45%; reasons if excluded 41%; relatives' discussion 48%; reasons if excluded 18%.

result.intervention: Two education sessions for NCHDs and consultants.

cycle2.result: DNAR status 35% and reasoning 32% (unchanged); patient discussion 61%; reasons if excluded 66%; relatives' discussion 48%; reasons if excluded 25%.

result.other_findings: Ceilings of care documentation increased (ICU admission three-fold, intubation two-fold) but stayed below 15%; a Ceilings of Care document was proposed.

result.setting: Surgical inpatients, Mercy University Hospital
result.standard: Malnutrition Universal Screening Tool (MUST) completion, accuracy and updating

cycle1.result: MUST scores completed in 83.3% but with significant inaccuracies (BMI, weight loss, acute disease effect); only 15.6% updated.

result.intervention: Malnutrition awareness week with dietitians and teaching sessions for healthcare staff on the MUST tool.
result.other_findings: Staff training gaps and inconsistent scoring were noted, though clinical teams identified at-risk patients by judgement and started interventions promptly.

result.setting: Shannon Clinic (smoke-free inpatient unit), Northern Ireland
result.standard: Correct prescribing of nicotine replacement therapy on drug charts

cycle1.result: 22% of drug charts had nicotine replacement therapy prescribed incorrectly.

result.intervention: Poster showing how to prescribe nicotine replacement therapy correctly placed on each ward.

cycle2.result: 0% of drug charts had nicotine replacement therapy prescribed incorrectly.

result.other_findings: There was no clear local guidance on NRT prescribing before the project.

result.topic: Cold ischaemia time in deceased donor kidney transplantation
result.setting: 14 UK transplant centres (National Transplant Access to Theatre audit)
result.standard: National cold ischaemia time recommendations

cycle1.result: Median CIT 10:55 (IQR 08:11-15:13) for DBD and 11:19 (IQR 08:31-15:10) for DCD; 42% of DCD and 15% of DBD organs exceeded national CIT recommendations.

result.other_findings: Median organ arrival to knife to skin 04:02; 16% of crossmatch results arrived after the organ; delays in 34%, mostly due to availability of surgical and anaesthetic teams, porters and theatre.

result.setting: Tertiary care centre, Dhulikhel Hospital
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: 356 day-of-surgery cancellations (77 in April rising to 101 in July); patient non-arrival 49%, medical unfitness 32%.

result.other_findings: Gastrointestinal surgery contributed 41% of cancellations, urology 22% and orthopaedics 20%; nearly four-fifths were potentially preventable.

result.setting: Department of General Surgery, Homerton University Hospital, London
result.standard: Priority (P-status) timeframes for surgery

cycle1.result: Only 3 patients had surgery within P2 targets; 79 (41%) had multiple booking requests; 52 (27%) potentially suitable for earlier emergency cholecystectomy, with deferral reasons documented for 8.

result.other_findings: 89 (47%) proceeded directly to surgery after booking; contributing factors included waiting times, emergency theatre capacity, ERCP timing and loss to follow-up.

result.topic: Clinician engagement in NHS net zero
result.setting: NHS trusts in England surveyed by Freedom of Information requests
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: In 2023 sustainability was the theme of 38.8% of audits, QI or research projects; 70.7% had a sustainability working group; 73.2% had a sustainability lead; 22.4% included sustainability in clinical governance meetings; 18.1% in junior doctor inductions.

result.other_findings: 44.4% of trusts had 0–5 clinicians in their sustainability working group.

result.setting: Three medical wards, University Hospital Waterford (acute hospital)
result.standard: Hospital guideline: medications prescribed by approved generic name, not brand name (with some exceptions)

cycle1.result: Of 257 prescribed medications, 63% (n=162) were prescribed by generic name and 95 by brand name.

result.other_findings: Enoxaparin was prescribed by brand name 10 times and generic name 3 times; piperacillin/tazobactam by brand 3 times and generic once; atorvastatin generic in 7 of 8 (88%). Education at induction, grand rounds and NCHD teaching was recommended.

result.topic: Bone health assessment after fragility fracture
result.setting: Orthogeriatric rehabilitation ward, Cork University Hospital
result.standard: Prescription of osteoporosis treatment and documented bone protection plan in orthogeriatric rehabilitation patients

cycle1.result: No patients prescribed targeted osteoporosis treatment; 1/12 had a documented bone protection plan; 9/12 on combination calcium and vitamin D.

result.intervention: Education of NCHDs to encourage proactive prescribing and documentation of the bone protection plan on the transfer summary.

cycle2.result: 8/10 prescribed osteoporosis treatment (2/10 oral bisphosphonate, 5/10 denosumab, 1/10 IV bisphosphonate); 6/10 on combination calcium and vitamin D.

result.other_findings: 10/12 in cycle 1 and 9/10 in cycle 2 had neck of femur fractures; all initial patients were over 14 days post-operative without a bone protection plan.

result.setting: Single London NHS hospital newly performing carotid endarterectomy during the pandemic
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: Questionnaire of 9 SpRs/consultants identified key pre-operative steps: MDT decision, vascular review, imaging, anaesthetic review, results (bloods, COVID swab, echo), theatre/bed booking, on-admission steps and post-op care.

result.intervention: Pre-operative checklist incorporated as smart text/flowsheet in the EPIC electronic record.

cycle2.result: All 9 doctors felt the checklist improved the service in all domains except bed availability and surgical delay.

result.other_findings: Bed availability and delay depended on HDU bed availability and on-the-day prioritisation.

result.topic: Cold ischaemia time in deceased donor pancreas and kidney transplantation
result.setting: Five UK transplant centres (National Transplant Access to Theatre audit)
result.standard: National cold ischaemia time recommendations

cycle1.result: 17% of DCD and 0% of DBD pancreases, and 17% of DCD and 4% of DBD kidneys, exceeded national CIT recommendations. Median CIT DBD kidney 12:08, DBD pancreas 10:13, DCD kidney 10:30, DCD pancreas 07:44.

result.other_findings: Delays were reported in 96% of transplants; median organ arrival to knife to skin 03:17.

result.setting: Northumbria Healthcare NHS Foundation Trust
result.standard: BSG guidelines: ERCP within 72h of pain onset; cholecystectomy during index admission or within two weeks of discharge

cycle1.dates: March to August 2020 compared with the same period in 2019
cycle1.result: Significant differences between COVID and pre-COVID groups, especially fewer hot procedures and fewer patients receiving definitive treatment during COVID; pre-COVID results similar to 2016 audit, in which 76% received definitive treatment.

result.other_findings: Most ERCP delays were due to the weekend effect; 16 of the 40 patients without definitive treatment re-presented with biliary flares or pancreatitis within a year.

result.setting: Mixed stroke/geriatric ward, Tallaght University Hospital (academic teaching hospital)
result.standard: International and European Clinical Practice Guidelines for sarcopenia screening and treatment

cycle1.result: No patients were screened for or had sarcopenia documented on admission; muscle strength assessed in 53% under geriatric care vs 38% under other teams; no patient had muscle quality analysis.

result.other_findings: 96% showed evidence or possibility of sarcopenia; 87% (n=13) under geriatric care had clinical nutrition assessment vs 60% (n=3) of over-65s under other teams. An education tool and SARC-F screening are planned.

result.setting: Beaumont Hospital, Dublin (level 4 hospital)
result.standard: NICE guidelines on Parkinson's disease

cycle1.result: 30% (9/30) received all PD medications on time; 70% (21/30) had at least one missed or delayed dose; 40% (12/30) had doses omitted; 50% (15/30) delayed (median 2.3 hours); prescribing errors in 20% (6/30).

result.intervention: Staff education to support understanding and compliance.
result.other_findings: Reasons for missed or delayed doses were absent in 76% (22/30); formal medication reconciliation in only 13% (4/30); no significant difference between medical and surgical services (p=0.64). Re-audit planned in 6 months.

result.setting: Adult emergency surgical patients, Victoria Hospital Kirkcaldy
result.standard: Proportion prescribed intravenous metronidazole when the oral route was available

cycle1.result: 43 (79.6%) prescribed IV metronidazole; 35/43 (81.4%) without clear contraindication to oral.

result.intervention: Education of prescribers on the similar pharmacokinetics of oral and intravenous metronidazole.

cycle2.result: 38 (62.3%) prescribed IV metronidazole; IV despite oral suitability fell to 34.2% (13/38) (risk ratio 0.42, 95% CI 0.26 to 0.67, p<0.0001).

result.other_findings: Prescribing oral metronidazole when suitable saved up to £10.53/day per patient.

result.setting: Community learning disability teams (Bexley, Bromley and Greenwich), Oxleas NHS Foundation Trust
result.standard: STOMP national standards derived from Royal College of Psychiatrists and NICE guidance

cycle1.result: not reported

cycle2.result: 85% on established psychotropics had a medication review within 6 months (100% assessed for response, 86% for side effects); 78% had capacity to consent documented; 81% of those lacking capacity had a best interests decision documented.

result.other_findings: All but one key finding improved compared with the 2019 audit, but adherence remained below 100%; re-audit planned for 2023.

result.setting: 8 hospital trusts across England (regional audit)
result.standard: Agreed pre-determined consent criteria, including alternatives offered, benefits and risks, and documented capacity to consent

cycle1.result: Capacity fulfilled and documented in 11.6% of hip and 13.9% of knee replacements; Consent Form 1 completed in 94.8% and 88.5%, procedure-specific in 74.0% and 72.1% respectively.

result.other_findings: 50 data sets per hospital (25 THR, 25 TKR). Digital consent with multimedia surgical videos was proposed.

result.topic: Falls risk assessment in older adults
result.setting: Large general practice with a mixed population (Kinsale Medical, Cork)
result.standard: World Guidelines for Falls Prevention and Management in Older Adults (September 2022): all patients 65 and over asked 3 Key Questions, appropriate referral, and routine falls prevention advice

cycle1.result: 3 Key Questions asked 0%; appropriate referrals 75%; falls risk advice 9%.

result.intervention: Practice education session, falls algorithm in every room and a consensus meeting.

cycle2.result: 3 Key Questions asked 50%; appropriate referrals 89%; falls risk advice 22%.

result.other_findings: Patients were those attending routine Chronic Disease Management reviews; adding falls risk assessment to the CDM template was recommended.

result.setting: District general hospital, Frimley Health NHS Foundation Trust
result.standard: National guidelines (NICE NG147, ACPGBI, GIRFT) recommending selective antibiotic use in uncomplicated diverticulitis

cycle1.result: Among immunocompetent patients with CT-confirmed uncomplicated diverticulitis (modified Hinchey ≤1A), 95.3% received antibiotics; 97% in the whole cohort.

result.other_findings: Complicated cases had higher CRP (148.1 vs 71.2 mg/L, p=0.0035) and WCC, were older and less often immunocompetent; 30-day reattendance was 8.4%.

result.setting: Single UK centre (Royal Surrey County Hospital NHS Foundation Trust)
result.standard: World Journal of Emergency Surgery Jerusalem guidelines: no postoperative antibiotics for uncomplicated appendicitis

cycle1.result: 54.3% of uncomplicated appendicitis cases (n=46) did not receive postoperative antibiotics; mean postoperative stay 23.3 hours.

cycle2.result: 78.3% of uncomplicated cases (n=46) did not receive postoperative antibiotics (p = 0.0024); mean postoperative stay 14.5 hours (p = 0.0002).

result.other_findings: No significant difference in complications and no C. difficile cases in either cycle.

result.setting: Plastic surgery inpatient referrals, Royal Sussex County Hospital (major trauma centre)
result.standard: Complete and appropriate online referrals with clinical photography

cycle1.result: 147 (14.2%) rejected; 63% of rejections inappropriate; 41.5% submitted without clinical photography; incomplete referrals 7.5%.

result.intervention: New referral form with a prerequisite referral checklist, wound assessment section and required clinical photography.

cycle2.result: 37 (22.0%) rejected; inappropriate referrals 70.3% of rejections (p=0.64); 19% without clinical photography (p=0.37); incomplete referrals 5.4% (p=0.07).

result.other_findings: Commonly omitted sections at baseline were results (70%), allergies (65%) and medication (16%).

result.topic: Preoperative weight loss and dysphagia in oesophageal cancer
result.setting: Single tertiary cancer centre, The Royal Marsden Hospital, London
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: Pre-operative weight loss correlated with complication rate (p=0.04) and weight loss 5–7 months post-operatively (p=0.001); 26 Grade 3/4 Clavien-Dindo complications.

result.other_findings: A criteria-specific nutritional pathway has been implemented and a prospective re-audit is planned.

result.topic: Perioperative practice in deceased donor kidney transplantation
result.setting: 14 UK transplant centres (National Transplant Access to Theatre audit)
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: 98.6% received pre-operative antibiotics; 91.1% (n=380) consultant surgeon-led, 60.1% consultant anaesthetist-led; central line 65.5%, arterial line 41.0%, advanced haemodynamic monitoring 25.4%; goal-directed fluid therapy 69.3%.

result.other_findings: Wide variation in practice; post-operative destinations were transplant ward 75.3%, HDU 10.1% and ICU 9.4%.

result.setting: 9 inpatient wards, Surrey and Borders Partnership NHS Foundation Trust
result.standard: NICE and Maudsley guidelines: baseline prolactin before starting medium or high-risk antipsychotics

cycle1.result: Baseline prolactin recorded in 33 of 76 on medium to high-risk antipsychotics (43%).

result.other_findings: 3 had elevated prolactin; only 1 managed appropriately and none had documented assessment of hyperprolactinaemia symptoms. Local guidelines and patient leaflets were recommended.

result.setting: Three hospitals including University Hospital Hairmyres, NHS Lanarkshire
result.standard: RCSEng and GIRFT operation note guidelines (total score 32), preferably typed

cycle1.result: Median GIRFT score 29 (IQR 27–31) for biliary surgeons vs 19 (IQR 16–21) for non-biliary surgeons (p<0.001); typed notes 94.4% vs 59.0% (p<0.001); no non-biliary surgeon achieved 32/32.

result.other_findings: Biliary surgeons performed 125 (22.2%) procedures and more emergency cholecystectomies (44.8% vs 35.1%, p=0.047). Mandated typed, standardised notes were recommended.

result.setting: Urology consultants and trainees across Scotland (electronic survey)
result.standard: European Association of Urology guidelines (recommend against pharmacological prophylaxis after TURP)

cycle1.result: 71.4% of responding urologists prescribed pharmacological VTE prophylaxis after TURP; 94.6% used TED stockings; none routinely prescribed prophylaxis on discharge.

result.other_findings: Response rate 56/113 (49.6%); 35.7% discharged patients with TED stockings. A 2002 UK audit found 14% used pharmacological prophylaxis.

result.setting: Princess of Wales Hospital and Neath Port Talbot Hospital
result.standard: Royal College of Radiologists gallbladder and biliary tree ultrasound reporting standards

cycle1.result: Gallbladder neck assessed 7.1%; bile echogenicity 17.1%; wall thickness 55.7%; CBD assessed 84.3%; CBD lumen measured 45.7%.

result.intervention: New local reporting protocol, educational posters and teaching sessions on gallbladder ultrasound reporting.

cycle2.result: Gallbladder neck assessed 77.8%; bile echogenicity 33.3%; wall thickness 75.6%; CBD assessed 97.8%; CBD lumen measured 44.4%.

result.other_findings: Bile echogenicity and CBD lumen measurement still needed improvement.

result.setting: Level 3 tertiary neonatal unit, 40 cots
result.standard: National Patient Safety Agency (NPSA) recommendations on gentamicin

cycle1.result: 18 gentamicin errors reported; 84% at prescribing and 16% at administration; 67% due to complexity of calculating a 36-hourly dosing interval.

result.intervention: PDSA cycles from July 2017: simplified standardised dosing interval, updated local monograph with example prescription, posters in prescribing areas, MDT feedback session, guideline promotion and error monitoring, lower-risk alternative antibiotic in low-risk babies, and gentamicin prescribing exercise at new doctor induction.
result.other_findings: Evaluation using Datix-reported errors was planned 3 months after implementation, with monthly audit to follow.

result.topic: Comprehensive geriatric assessment after falls in care homes
result.setting: Four Counties primary care network, care homes
result.standard: HEE Framework for Enhanced Health in Care Homes 2020: CGA within 7 days of readmission to a care home after a hospital episode for a fall

cycle1.result: 15% compliance with the 7-day CGA; medication review within 7 days 42%; falls assessment questionnaire within 7 days 23%.

result.intervention: System-wide plan: improved reporting of care home falls to OTs, protected pharmacist time for care home medication reviews, and in-person weekly care-coordinator meetings.

cycle2.result: Compliance improved from 15% to 57%; medication review in 7 days 80%; falls assessment questionnaire in 7 days 70%.

result.other_findings: not reported

result.topic: ECG review in memory assessment services
result.setting: Memory assessment team, single mental health unit in the North West of England
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: 781 (44%) had an ECG by the MAT, of which 452 (58%) were abnormal; previously unknown findings included 8 AF, 4 trifascicular block and 19 LVH; 64 (8%) had bradycardia.

result.intervention: Cardiology consulted on significant abnormalities and GPs informed; all ECGs completed by the MAT now screened at the point of filing into the notes.
result.other_findings: Described as a closed audit, but no re-audit figures are given.

result.topic: Lying and standing blood pressure measurement
result.setting: Morriston Hospital, acute medical, surgical wards and emergency department, Swansea
result.standard: RCP National Audit of Inpatient Falls (Falls and Fragility Fracture Audit Programme) method for lying-standing blood pressure

cycle1.result: Staff survey (PDSA1): 47% measured standing BP between 1-3 minutes.

result.intervention: Grand round presentation and work-based tutorial sessions.

cycle2.result: PDSA2: over 25% more participants allowed patients to rest before initial BP; about 7% improvement in repositioning; standing BP at 1-3 minutes doubled from 47%.

result.other_findings: 57 staff members participated across the survey; significant variation in timing and measurement was found.

result.topic: Open tibial fracture management against BOAST
result.setting: Major trauma centres across all four Scottish trauma networks, multicentre
result.standard: BOAST open fracture guidelines

cycle1.result: Complete compliance with BOAST documented in 8.8% of cases; significant variation between regions.

result.other_findings: Complications: infection 24%, return to theatre 17%, soft-tissue failure 9.7%, amputation 7.1%; no association between BOAST compliance and outcomes. Gaps included antibiotic timing, combined ortho-plastic approach and soft-tissue cover within 72 hours.

result.topic: Antimicrobial prescribing compliance with local guidelines
result.setting: Six geriatric wards, Broomfield Hospital, Mid-South Essex NHS Foundation Trust
result.standard: Microguide local antimicrobial guidance; indication, route, duration and choice of antibiotic

cycle1.result: 99 of 168 patients on antibiotics; Microguide compliance 39-65% (mean 53%); indication and duration on drug charts 89%.

result.intervention: Weekly microbiology consultant-led ward rounds, education for junior doctors, nurses and consultants, streamlined IT access to Microguide, AMS meetings and prescribing in simulation sessions.

cycle2.result: Compliance 70-90% (mean 83%); indication and duration on drug charts 95%.

result.other_findings: Co-amoxiclav (n = 45) and Tazocin (n = 14) were the most used antibiotics; co-amoxiclav for UTI and Tazocin without microbiology approval were targeted.

result.topic: Mental health documentation in paediatric dermatology
result.setting: Tertiary dermatology centre, children and young people on systemic medication
result.standard: BSPAD consensus statement on assessment and support of mental health in children and young people with skin conditions: ask about and document psychosocial impact

cycle1.result: 80.2% of clinic letters documented mental health and/or QoL impact: PROM and comment 58.0%, comment only 27.5%, PROM only 14.8%.

result.other_findings: 540 letters from 47 patients (37 eczema, 10 psoriasis); 18/47 under CAMHS and 14 referred to Psychological Medicine.

result.setting: Tertiary centre CEPOD emergency general surgery list, St James's Hospital, Leeds
result.standard: GIRFT procedure-specific operation note guidelines

cycle1.result: Five consecutive operation notes each for laparoscopic appendicectomy, laparoscopic cholecystectomy, open inguinal hernia and emergency laparotomy/small bowel resection scored against GIRFT.

result.intervention: All surgeons educated on the four GIRFT guidelines.

cycle2.result: Median scores improved by +12.3% (p = 0.033) LA, +0.6% (p = 0.500) LC, +25.5% (p = 0.006) IH, +9.5% (p = 0.030) ELS; best was LA in cycle 2, median 72.7% (IQR 8.5).

result.other_findings: 40 notes assessed in total. ChatGPT-generated notes scored 32.3-47.7% lower than cycle 2 surgeon notes, though improved by a median of +29.7% over five generations.

result.topic: Behaviour that challenges in learning disability
result.setting: Inpatient and community learning disability services
result.standard: NICE QS101 Learning disability: behaviour that challenges

cycle1.result: Initial assessment 97%; named lead practitioner 95% community and 100% inpatients; care and support plan 93%; specialist behavioural support 90% community; supported to choose where to live 55%; antipsychotics 77%, of whom 65% had MDT review, 45% reviewed within 3 months and 70% reviewed 6-monthly.

result.other_findings: 100% of restrictive interventions had a documented review; PBS plan review and antipsychotic physical health reviews need improvement.

result.topic: Timing of cholecystectomy after gallstone pancreatitis
result.setting: University Hospital Monklands, NHS Lanarkshire
result.standard: National guidelines: cholecystectomy during index admission or within two weeks of discharge for mild gallstone pancreatitis

cycle1.result: 30 (50.8%) operated; 9 (15.2%) timely; mean delay 11.2 weeks; 19 (32%) readmitted, 10 with recurrent pancreatitis.

result.intervention: Expedited cholecystectomy pathway and live tracker.

cycle2.result: 15 (50%) operated; 13 (43%) timely, 12 during index admission and 1 within 2 weeks of discharge.

result.other_findings: Root causes were lack of structured follow-up, delays in anaesthetic clearance and limited theatre availability.

result.setting: District general hospital, Dudley Group NHS Foundation Trust
result.standard: National guidance on timely surgery, preoperative imaging and postoperative antibiotic prescribing for emergency appendicectomy

cycle1.result: Surgery within 24 hours of decision in 73.4%; 45.0% of delays justified, 41.0% due to theatre capacity; preoperative imaging 61.3%; acute pathology on histology 79.0%; postoperative antibiotics 67.2%.

result.other_findings: 27.3% of CT-diagnosed and 25.0% of ultrasound-diagnosed appendicitis were histologically negative; antibiotic choice and duration varied widely. Re-audit planned.

result.topic: Smoking status documentation and cessation support
result.setting: Single centre, adult fracture inpatients, Imperial College Healthcare NHS Trust, London
result.standard: NICE guidance: all patients admitted to secondary care receive smoking cessation advice

cycle1.result: Smoking status undocumented in 19.6% (n=42); among 33 smokers: cessation service offered 45.5%, clinical discussion 57.6%, NRT 33.3%, Smoking Assessment Form 39.4%.

result.intervention: Educational posters, teaching session by the smoking cessation team, and presentation of first-cycle findings at a local meeting.

cycle2.result: Undocumented smoking status 7.8% (n=11) (p=0.002); among 30 smokers: cessation offer 30.0% (p=0.21), discussion 43.3% (p=0.26), NRT 16.7% (p=0.13), form 23.3% (p=0.17).

result.other_findings: Documentation improved but delivery of cessation support did not.

result.topic: Dermatology referral acceptance by referrer role
result.setting: Dermatology services, Swansea Bay and Hywel Dda University Health Boards
result.standard: Local dermatology referral guidelines

cycle1.result: 47% accepted overall; 87% from doctors, 8% nurses, 5% PAs; acceptance 13% for nurse and 20% for PA referrals, highest for doctors.

result.intervention: Targeted feedback to referrers via the electronic referral system and reinforcement of local referral guidelines.

cycle2.result: 59% accepted overall; 86% from doctors; nurse acceptance 38%, PA 28%.

result.other_findings: Doctor referrals remained more likely to be accepted than non-doctor referrals.

result.topic: Antimicrobial prescribing compliance with local guidelines
result.setting: Acute urology admissions, tertiary urology centre, Liverpool University Hospitals
result.standard: Local antimicrobial guidelines across four domains: initiation, changes, discharge and duration

cycle1.result: Initial antibiotic choice 59%; duration 61%; subsequent changes 86%; discharge 61%; composite compliance 43%.

result.intervention: QR-code posters, teaching sessions and a faculty meeting.

cycle2.result: Initial choice 82%; duration 68%; subsequent changes 81%; discharge 61%; composite compliance 53% (33% compliant, 20% justified deviations, 48% unjustified deviations).

result.other_findings: Discharge antibiotic choice stayed at 61%; length of stay differences (p=0.002) reflected illness severity rather than compliance.

result.topic: Emergency cholecystectomy for acute biliary disease
result.setting: Royal Surrey NHS Foundation Trust
result.standard: More than 80% of eligible patients to undergo cholecystectomy within 8 days of acute biliary presentation

cycle1.result: HES showed 20% compliance; 60% incorrectly coded; of correctly coded, 58% had cholecystectomy within 8 days; 70% of weekend biliary ultrasound requests not performed.

result.intervention: Stakeholder consultation and a pathway disseminated via education, trust induction and a protocol, with increased ultrasound provision (4 weekday and 2 weekend patients/day), one theatre session per week and senior clinician-led coding.

cycle2.result: 100% of eligible patients had cholecystectomy within 8 days; no waiting list patient had an emergency admission.

result.other_findings: 21% of waiting list patients had previous biliary attendances and 39% were not referred for surgery.

result.setting: 23 UK adult cardiac surgery centres, national audit
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: Resternotomy rate 3.6% (3.37-3.85), varying 0.69% to 7.6% between centres; mortality 15.0% (12.7-17.5).

result.other_findings: Median ICU stay 5 days; 89.3% transfused red cells (median 4 units); renal replacement therapy 23.4%.

result.setting: Mental health department, three sites, BCUHB, North Wales
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: 249 bleeps; appropriate bleeps about 70% East, 90% West and 15% Central; deferrable 70% East, almost 95% Central, 30% West.

result.other_findings: Discharge paperwork, prescribing and routine reviews were the commonest bleep reasons; suggestions included planning TTOs ahead and using trained nurses for ECGs and phlebotomy.

result.setting: Galway University Hospital
result.standard: 2023 National Clinical Guideline for Stroke for the UK and Ireland

cycle1.result: Pre-pathway: 10.1% seen directly via AMU; median LoS 1.08 days; 28.2% managed within 24 hours; CT brain 94.8%; stroke specialist review 82.1%; inpatient echo 42.9%.

result.intervention: New TIA pathway encouraging an ambulatory approach via the Acute Medical Unit.

cycle2.result: 28.5% seen directly via AMU; median LoS 0.65 days; 35.7% managed within 24 hours; neuroimaging 96.4%; CT 89.3%; MRI without prior CT 75%; stroke specialist review 96.4%; echo 35.7%, Holter 21.4%.

result.other_findings: Admission under the stroke service rose from 26% to 42.9%, with shorter LoS under AMU or stroke services.

result.topic: Best medical therapy in chronic limb-threatening ischaemia
result.setting: Vascular inpatients, University Hospitals of Leicester NHS Trust
result.standard: ESVS 2023 guidelines and Global Vascular Guidelines: antiplatelet, high-intensity statin, lipid profile, BP <140/90, smoking cessation advice, HbA1c within 3 months

cycle1.result: Statin 80%; antiplatelet 60%; lipid profile 1/34 (2.9%); discharge BP at target 29/35 (82.9%); smoking cessation documented 5/36 (13.9%); HbA1c within 3 months 14/49 (28.6%).

result.other_findings: Structured pathways, automated prompts and routine lifestyle documentation were proposed.

result.topic: Carer involvement in liaison psychiatry assessments
result.setting: Three liaison psychiatry teams (Torbay, Exeter, North Devon), Devon Partnership Trust, emergency departments
result.standard: PLAN standards, NICE suicide and safety planning guidance and Triangle of Care; target 90% carer contact and information-sharing form completion

cycle1.result: Carers not routinely contacted and information-sharing form infrequently completed.

result.intervention: QI team including a carer representative; staff survey, driver diagram and change ideas focused on workplace culture, with monthly rolling audit of 5 patients per team.

cycle2.result: SPC data initially within normal variability, particularly for documentation; recent positive trend without figures.

result.other_findings: Project continuing until September 2026.

result.setting: Colorectal surgery department, Bristol Royal Infirmary, elective ERAS patients
result.standard: Elective colorectal ERAS pathway: early postoperative nutritional drinks and avoidance of postoperative opioids

cycle1.result: Early postoperative nutrition and/or solid food in 60 (68.2%); nutritional drinks prescribed for 39 (44.3%), average 3 days to prescribe; systemic opioids avoided in 7 (7.9%).

result.intervention: Face-to-face education for new colorectal junior doctors and posters in the doctors' office.
result.other_findings: 104 patients identified, 16 excluded for insufficient data. Second cycle planned.

result.setting: National Early Inflammatory Arthritis Audit, rheumatology services in England and Wales
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: 79.7% of axSpA patients had symptoms >6 months before assessment vs 33.7% RA and 76.0% mechanical back pain; median referral to assessment 36 days vs 24 days RA (P < 0.001) and 39 days MBP.

result.other_findings: Disease education provided to 77.5% of axSpA vs 97.8% of RA patients eligible for EIA pathway follow-up.

result.topic: Diagnostic yield of muscle biopsy in inflammatory myopathy
result.setting: Luton and Dunstable Hospital, single centre
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: Overall diagnostic yield 50% (18/36); yield 89% with raised CK, 83% with wasting, 51% with weakness; quadriceps yield 62%, calf 80%.

result.other_findings: Authors propose a predictive referral model to improve biopsy selection.

result.topic: Consent to treatment documentation under the Mental Health Act
result.setting: Three forensic low secure inpatient wards, Newsam Centre
result.standard: Mental Health Act Code of Practice

cycle1.result: CTT medication list documented on online drug chart in 24/31; 27 prescribed medications per CTT, 1 not; qualifying T3 reviewed every two years in 4, not in 1.

result.intervention: Leaflet outlining guidance distributed to staff; weekly checks in team meetings recommended.
result.other_findings: 28/31 admitted over three months (12 on T2, 16 on T3); two patients on Section 62. Re-audit planned.

result.topic: Urinary catheter use in older patients
result.setting: Emergency department, Tallaght University Hospital, Dublin, patients over 75
result.standard: Best practice guidelines for indwelling urinary catheter insertion

cycle1.result: Catheterisation consistent with best practice in 20 (91%); indication clearly documented in 8 (36%); none removed in ED (0%).

result.intervention: Guideline created on indications for catheterisation; education session for medical and nursing staff planned.
result.other_findings: Re-audit planned.

result.setting: Vascular surgery, Royal Stoke University Hospital and Royal Blackburn Teaching Hospital
result.standard: GMC 2008 guidance, Consent: patients and doctors making decisions together

cycle1.result: Intended benefits documented in 100%; NVR inclusion 0%; documented risks: maximum 15 (79%), median 8 (42%), minimum 3 (16%) of 19 complications.

cycle2.result: Benefits 100%; NVR inclusion 80%; documented risks: maximum 16 (84%), median 10 (53%), minimum 4 (21%); 16 items improved and 9 complications recorded above 50%.

result.other_findings: 45 infrainguinal bypass consents across audit and re-audit; authors call for a national pre-printed vascular procedure-specific consent form.

result.topic: Axillary management of sentinel node macrometastasis
result.setting: Leeds Breast Unit, Leeds Teaching Hospitals
result.standard: Association of Breast Surgery guideline on management of sentinel lymph node macrometastasis

cycle1.result: Completion ANC 56 (44.1%), axillary radiotherapy 37 (29.1%), no further treatment 34 (26.8%); all with >3 macrometastases (n=10) had cANC; 58% of post-menopausal BCS patients with ER+HER2- T1 tumours (n=12) had further axillary treatment contrary to guideline.

result.other_findings: Where the guideline stated uncertainty, further axillary treatment was frequent: pre-menopausal 82%, T2 73%, lymphovascular invasion 74%, extranodal spread 77%.

result.topic: Anaesthesia and outcomes after hip fracture surgery
result.setting: UK Anaesthesia Sprint Audit of Practice, national, linked to National Hip Fracture Database
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: Mortality 165/11,085 (1.5%) at 5 days and 563/11,085 (5.1%) at 30 days, not associated with anaesthetic technique; OR for 5-day mortality 0.983 (0.973-0.994) per 5 mmHg systolic increment, p = 0.0016.

result.other_findings: A mean 20% relative fall in systolic pressure correlated with 1.44 ml hyperbaric bupivacaine.

result.topic: Bone health assessment and FRAX in older inpatients
result.setting: Colwell Ward, Isle of Wight NHS Trust, one-day inpatient audit
result.standard: NICE criteria for bone health assessment

cycle1.result: 100% met NICE criteria for BHA; BHA mentioned in 2/30 (6.7%); FRAX calculated in 0; vitamin D checked 14/30 (46.7%); calcium 28/30 (93.3%); vitamin D and calcium prescribed 17/30 (56.7%); ARM started in 2/30 (6.7%).

result.intervention: FRAX scoring included in the CGA piloted by the acute frailty team.
result.other_findings: Re-audit recommended after full CGA implementation.

result.setting: 24-bed reablement unit, Our Lady's Hospice and Care Services, Dublin
result.standard: PPI prescribing guidelines on indication and dose

cycle1.result: 24 (60%) prescribed a PPI; 19 (79.2%) inappropriate.

result.intervention: Pharmacist review with recommendations to the medical team: 8 (42.1%) dose reduced, 5 (26.3%) discontinued.
result.other_findings: 6 (31.6%) inappropriate PPIs unsuitable for review due to bleed risk, ongoing reflux or other reasons.

result.topic: Pulmonary screening in paediatric connective tissue disease
result.setting: Five UK tertiary paediatric rheumatology centres, multicentre
result.standard: Audit standards derived from national and international guidelines on pulmonary screening in juvenile CTD (proposed standards)

cycle1.dates: Patients seen within the last 12 months
cycle1.result: Pulmonary involvement identified in 27/68 (39.7%) jSLE, 5/41 (12.2%) jDM, 4/7 (57.1%) jSSc and 3/12 (25.0%) jMCTD; 50% or fewer had regular assessment of pulmonary symptoms and signs during follow-up.

result.other_findings: Lung function testing and ILD imaging were used inconsistently at diagnosis and follow-up; standards for screening were proposed.

result.setting: Aberdeen Royal Infirmary and Woodend Hospital, ankle fracture ORIF
result.standard: BOA Standards for Trauma: management of ankle fractures

cycle1.result: CT for complex fractures 47.74%; post-operatively full weight-bearing 14.43% and partial 12.45%; clinic follow-up within 6 weeks 97.01%; after first clinic full weight-bearing 24.88% and partial 25.87%.

result.intervention: Results presented at M&M meeting; post-operation note template to be revised and a poster on BOA weight-bearing and imaging guidance to be introduced.
result.other_findings: 155 complex and 46 non-complex fractures. Re-audit planned for 2024.

result.setting: All UK and Irish public hospitals, 5th National Audit Project
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: not reported

result.other_findings: Methods paper describing reporting, categorisation of awareness reports and analysis for NAP5.

result.setting: Our Lady of Lourdes Hospital, Drogheda, hip fracture patients over 60
result.standard: Irish Hip Fracture Standards 1-6 (Irish Hip Fracture Database)

cycle1.result: Admitted to orthopaedic ward within 4 hours 56%; surgery within 48 hours 60%; pressure ulcers 2%; IHFS4-6 98%; all IHFS met in 32%.

result.intervention: Hip Fracture Pathway Subgroup, IHFS1 breaches audit, orthogeriatric input at orthopaedic inductions, weekly MDT meetings, nutritional hip fracture pathway and a Fracture Liaison Service ANP.

cycle2.result: Ward within 4 hours 71%; surgery within 48 hours 66%; pressure ulcers 3%; IHFS4-6 87%; all IHFS met in 43%.

result.other_findings: Lower IHFS4-6 in 2020 reflected COVID-19 redeployment of the orthogeriatric service and MDT; €90,000 Best Practice Tariff funding achieved.

result.topic: AI detection of occult hip fractures
result.setting: Queen Elizabeth University Hospital, Glasgow, trauma patients with inconclusive pelvic radiographs
result.standard: CT as gold standard for occult neck of femur fracture

cycle1.result: RBfracture sensitivity 94.1%, NPV 94.4%, specificity 37.0%; clinicians sensitivity 39.1%, specificity 63.8%; Gemini sensitivity 47.1%, specificity 58.7%.

result.other_findings: Gemini detected the single fracture missed by RBfracture.

result.setting: Geriatric medicine teams, Mater Misericordiae University Hospital, Dublin
result.standard: Hospital delirium guidelines: 'new confusion' on INEWS2 and 4AT screening, and management guidelines

cycle1.result: 37 (47%) had delirium; 'new confusion' documented on INEWS2 in 7 (19%); 4AT documented in 3 (8%); management guidelines followed for all patients.

result.other_findings: INEWS2 'new confusion' sensitivity 19% and specificity 100% for delirium. Further staff education recommended.

result.setting: High-volume tertiary centre, Guy's and St Thomas' NHS Foundation Trust, London
result.standard: BAETS/ENT UK postoperative standards: voice documentation within 24 hours, FNE, SLT/laryngology referral, validated PROMs

cycle1.result: Voice documentation within 24 hours 89%; 35% of symptomatic patients had FNE within 24 hours; PROMs (VHI-10, EAT-10) not routinely used.

result.intervention: Structured proforma, SLT referral pathway and PROM integration.

cycle2.result: Early second-cycle data indicated improved documentation and referral rates; no figures given.

result.other_findings: Voice changes in 20% (2% persisting at 3 months); RLN injury 4%, two with bilateral vocal cord palsy.

result.setting: Long-term care setting, University Hospital Waterford
result.standard: Recent diabetes guidelines recommending individualised management in frailty or comorbidity

cycle1.result: Median HbA1c 44 mmol/l (range 29-116); 23/47 on oral agents (median HbA1c 51 mmol/l); 6/47 on insulin; HbA1c checked in previous 6 months in 36/47; 1 hypoglycaemic episode.

result.other_findings: 41/47 had Clinical Frailty Score 6 or more; all on a diabetic diet; tight control suggests scope to rationalise treatment.

result.setting: 51 general practices in Haringey, London
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: Trained practices averaged 526 HIV tests per year; testing rate 2.29 tests/1000 registered patients/year in trained and 1.54 in untrained practices; 18.0 positives/1000 tests.

result.intervention: Sexual Health in Practice (SHIP) multifaceted education for GPs and practice nurses, with resources to practices.

cycle2.dates: 19 months during and 5 months after training
cycle2.result: Trained practices projected 1556 tests per year; rate 6.66 (p=0.0016) in trained vs 1.90 (p=0.5195) in untrained practices; 16.7 positives/1000 tests (p=0.7908).

result.other_findings: 39 of 51 practices had at least one trained individual; new diagnoses rose from 9.5 to 22 per year.

result.setting: Seven Welsh colorectal multidisciplinary teams, multicentre
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: TNT recommended in 21 cases; 11 managed with organ preservation intent; short-course radiotherapy use varied markedly between centres.

result.other_findings: MSI status was often pending at decision-making; high-risk T3 management varied between TNT and upfront surgery.

result.topic: Vitamin D supplementation in older adults
result.setting: Frailty Intervention Team, level 5 emergency department, Mater Misericordiae University Hospital, Dublin
result.standard: Department of Health 2020 guidance: all adults 65 and over supplemented with 15 micrograms vitamin D daily

cycle1.result: Compliance 65% (n=39).

result.intervention: Policy update and education after the initial audit.

cycle2.result: Compliance 61% (n=40); 68% (n=45) prescribed vitamin D, of whom 89% (n=40) at least 15 micrograms; 32% (n=21) none; 8% (n=5) lower doses.

result.other_findings: Median Clinical Frailty Score 5; results felt to reflect community prescribing rather than acute practice.

result.topic: Frailty and survival after emergency laparotomy
result.setting: National Emergency Laparotomy Audit data linked to ONS mortality
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: Frailty associated with death beyond 90 days; adjusted HR vs CFS 1-3: CFS 4 1.86, CFS 5 2.23, CFS 6 3.26, CFS 8 5.80, CFS 9 5.36.

result.other_findings: Observational Cox model with hospital-level random effects.

result.topic: Core surgical training theatre and clinic access
result.setting: Core surgical trainees across 14 trusts, East of England
result.standard: JCST Quality Indicators for core surgical training

cycle1.result: Consistent theatre access 45% (9/21); scheduled clinic time 19% (4/21); over 75% unable to attend mandatory teaching.

result.intervention: Findings presented to the Surgical Trainee Committee and trust leadership, leading to rota redesign, resource reallocation and improved planning.

cycle2.result: Theatre access 78% (20/26); clinic time 50% (13/26); over 75% still unable to attend mandatory teaching.

result.other_findings: April 2024 cycle: theatre 68% (21/31), clinic 39% (12/31); response rates 47%, 69% and 58%. Six trusts improved but three showed no progress.

result.setting: Pre-operative assessment clinic, Leighton Hospital, Crewe
result.standard: EUA 2024 and GIRFT 2025 guidance on preoperative urine testing and treatment of asymptomatic bacteriuria; 100% standard

cycle1.result: MSU uptake 3.8%; suboptimal management of positive cultures.

result.intervention: New screening pathways in the pre-operative assessment clinic and microbiology team.

cycle2.result: MSU uptake 47.9% (35/73); 13 (37.1%) culture-positive, of whom only 3 had documented antibiotic treatment.

result.other_findings: No postoperative infections or infection-related admissions. Further re-audit planned after protocol refinement.

result.topic: Next of kin communication documentation after surgery
result.setting: Conquest Hospital, Hastings, laparotomy patients
result.standard: NICE CG83 1.13; best practice of documenting NOK discussion within 12 hours

cycle1.result: Documented NOK discussions 3-5 days post-operatively in 36%; NOK update after ITU step-down in 33% of 10 patients.

result.intervention: Communication skills workshop for surgical juniors and coloured cards in notes folders to flag patients needing NOK discussions.
result.other_findings: Junior confidence (score 4-5) rose after the workshop: DNACPR 31% to 89%, end-of-life 31% to 55%, emotionally charged 31% to 78%. Documentation re-audit planned.

result.topic: Ambulatory ultrasound waiting times in surgical assessment unit
result.setting: Surgical Assessment Unit, district general hospital, ambulatory RIF and RUQ pain
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: Median wait from arrival to ultrasound 2 hours 15 minutes (range 59 minutes to 3 hours 39 minutes).

result.intervention: Two daily ultrasound slots for SAU patients negotiated with radiology.

cycle2.result: Median wait 1 hour 5 minutes (range 4 minutes to 2 hours 20 minutes); 48% reduction.

result.other_findings: Average reduction in waiting time 1 hour 10 minutes.

result.setting: Four central London hospitals, paediatric appendicectomy, multicentre
result.standard: GIRFT guidelines on post-operative antibiotic prescribing in paediatric appendicitis

cycle1.result: Compliance 46-75% between hospitals (p=0.08); average 20.5 cases per site (range 13-34); median 4.5 days antibiotics after uncomplicated appendicectomy.

result.intervention: Findings presented at governance events; targeted education for junior doctors, clear antibiotic plans in operation notes and empowering juniors to challenge prescriptions.
result.other_findings: Main non-compliance was continuing antibiotics after uncomplicated appendicectomy.

result.setting: Portiuncula University Hospital, Ballinasloe, acute general hospital
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: Drivers identified: lack of or delayed stroke team referral, transcription/prescription errors, low rate of medication counselling before discharge, and frequent medication changes.

result.intervention: Planned: education on best practice in stroke and dedicated specialist pharmacist input.
result.other_findings: Phase B prospectively included a further 20 patients with feedback; patients found written discharge information unclear.

result.setting: Breast unit, Barking Havering and Redbridge University Trust
result.standard: National standards on imaging for gynaecomastia (not named)

cycle1.result: Ultrasound performed in all; all P1 and P2 patients were U1/U2 and M1/M2; mammography in 0/19 P1, 20/113 P2 and 4/11 P3; one P3 biopsy (M4U4) showed invasive carcinoma.

result.other_findings: 6 biopsies in P1, P2 and no-P-value patients were benign; authors propose no imaging for typical P1/P2 gynaecomastia.

result.topic: Best medical therapy in peripheral arterial disease
result.setting: Vascular inpatients, Ninewells Hospital, Dundee
result.standard: VSGBI cardiovascular risk reduction framework: BMT, gastroprotection, HbA1c and lipid assessment

cycle1.result: Antiplatelet 124/153 (81.1%); anticoagulation 60/153 (39.2%); statin 122/153 (79.7%); gastroprotection 54/153 (35.3%); HbA1c 27/153 (17.7%); lipid profile 19/153 (12.4%).

result.intervention: Surgical team teaching sessions and departmental posters.

cycle2.result: Antiplatelet 50/60 (83.3%); anticoagulation 30/60 (50.0%); statin 48/60 (80.0%); gastroprotection 40/60 (66.7%); HbA1c 18/60 (30.0%); lipid profile 39/60 (65.0%).

result.other_findings: Most admissions were for chronic limb-threatening ischaemia and diabetic foot infection.

result.setting: Emergency department, University Hospital Limerick
result.standard: HSE 2021 algorithm for early identification and management of delirium in ED/AMAU and UL Hospitals Group ED delirium screening bundle; 100% expected compliance

cycle1.result: 70% screened with the 4AT; 9 patients not screened (30% variance against standard); 4 cases of delirium identified.

result.intervention: Results discussed at staff meeting and daily huddles with an ED poster; planned staff re-education, blue 'Screen me with 4AT' triage sticker and Delirium Champion of the Day.
result.other_findings: Awareness of delirium screening was satisfactory but documentation compliance was moderately poor.

result.topic: Age Friendly Health Systems assessment documentation
result.setting: Geriatric Emergency Medicine Unit, emergency department, University Hospital Limerick
result.standard: Age Friendly Health Systems conceptual framework

cycle1.result: Compliance 0-100% across domains; best for EWS, mobility, falls history and 4AT; hydration and 'What Matters' documentation 0%; otherwise broadly over 50%.

cycle2.result: Further improvement in lying and standing blood pressure and polypharmacy assessments.

result.other_findings: First re-audit (December 2023 to January 2024, 15 charts) showed improvement across all assessments, with 100% in CFS, cognition, comorbidities and nutrition. Care preference documentation remains a focus.

result.topic: Clinic non-attendance and text message reminders
result.setting: Integrated Care Programme for the Older Person community specialist team, Galway, rural and urban clinics
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: Attendance 63%; DNA rate 20%; rural attendance 56%, urban 64%.

cycle2.result: Attendance 68%; DNA rate 15% (p = 0.39); rural attendance 73%, urban 62% (p-interaction = 0.15).

result.other_findings: Follow-up attendance 69% vs new CGA 57%, DNA 14% vs 25% (p = 0.02); commonest could-not-attend reasons were unsuitable time (n = 26) and illness (n = 15).

result.setting: 216 centres in 39 countries, EuroSurg collaborative
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: 90-day mortality 19.4%; surgical 13.9%; non-operative 33.7%.

result.other_findings: Presentations: obstruction 54.7%, haemorrhage 21.0%, perforation 11.4%; 13.9% presented while awaiting elective surgery; stenting in 4.0%.

result.setting: Vascular surgery, Royal Stoke University Hospital and Royal Blackburn Teaching Hospital
result.standard: GMC 2008 guidance, Consent: patients and doctors making decisions together

cycle1.result: Intended benefits documented in 90%; NVR inclusion 0%; documented risks: maximum 11 (79%), median 6 (43%), minimum 3 (21%) of 14 complications.

cycle2.result: Benefits 87%; NVR inclusion 60%; documented risks: maximum 13 (93%), median 7 (50%), minimum 5 (36%); 12 items improved and 6 complications recorded above 50%.

result.other_findings: 65 carotid endarterectomy consents across audit and re-audit; authors call for a national pre-printed vascular procedure-specific consent form.

result.setting: Vascular surgery, Norfolk and Norwich University Hospital
result.standard: Local CCG varicose vein referral criteria (April 2021)

cycle1.result: 158 (63.2%) failed criteria but actual rejection rate was 44.9%, with significant variation between consultants (P<0.001); 62.9% of ineligible patients seen had investigations.

result.intervention: Results presented at clinical governance on 09/03/22 and change implemented.

cycle2.result: 96 (63.7%) failed criteria; 15.5% improvement in appropriate outright rejection (p = 0.02); no significant difference between consultants (P = 0.46).

result.other_findings: Fewer inappropriate clinic attendances reduced downstream investigations and waiting times.

result.setting: Geriatric rehabilitation ward, SCGH/OPH, Perth
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: 36 pressure injuries; documented in medical admission 21%, medical notes 33%, MDT meetings 17%, discharge letters 22%; mean delay from nursing identification to medical and MDT documentation 17 and 16 days.

result.other_findings: Stages: 39% stage 1, 42% stage 2, 3% stage 3, 6% suspected deep, 11% unstageable; mean length of stay 50 days.

result.topic: Anaesthesia and outcomes after hip fracture surgery
result.setting: National Hip Fracture Database, national dataset
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: No difference in 5-day (2.8% vs 2.8%, p = 0.991) or 30-day mortality (7.0% vs 7.5%, p = 0.053) between general (30,130) and spinal (22,999) anaesthesia.

result.other_findings: 24-hour mortality higher with cemented than uncemented hemiarthroplasty (1.6% vs 1.2%, p = 0.030).

result.setting: St Mary's Hospital, Imperial College Healthcare NHS Trust, major trauma centre, London
result.standard: NICE and local trauma call guidelines

cycle1.result: 31% lacked completed sign-in sheets; team roles recorded in 22%; admitting surgical specialty present from start in 55%; attendance: Major Trauma/Neurosurgery 94%, Anaesthetics 64%, Trauma and Orthopaedics 50%, General Surgery 40%.

result.intervention: Proposed: tap-in card automated sign-in, documentation templates and staff surveys on attendance barriers.
result.other_findings: Documentation was poorer out of hours; barriers included unfamiliarity with electronic systems, consecutive trauma calls and faulty computers.

result.setting: Chester-le-Street Adult Learning Disability Community Team
result.standard: NICE NG11 and STOMP initiative

cycle1.result: Rationale documented 100%; used with psychological interventions 100%; comorbidities identified 100%; review within 3-4 weeks 20%; treatment duration documented 0%; patient/carer involvement 40%; MDT review within 3 months 40%.

result.other_findings: Recommendations: standardised early reviews, documentation of duration, carer engagement and timely MDT reviews.

result.topic: Extended VTE prophylaxis after major abdominal cancer surgery
result.setting: Bedfordshire Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust; patients treated surgically for colorectal cancer
result.standard: NICE 2018: 28 days of post-operative VTE prophylaxis after major abdominal cancer surgery

cycle1.result: 84% compliance overall (88% elective, 55% emergency). Documented plan for extended prophylaxis in 82% of recipients and 12% of non-recipients.

result.intervention: Planned: education, posters and improved electronic discharge processes; second cycle being collected prospectively from 25/01/2023.
result.other_findings: 89% of operations were elective and 11% emergency; compliance was lower in emergency cases.

result.topic: Laser-assisted photodynamic therapy for basal cell carcinoma
result.setting: Tertiary centre, North Bristol NHS Trust / University of Bristol
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: 132 lesions in 33 patients; rolling recurrence 2.8% MAL vs 1.7% ALA; 2-year recurrence 5.7% MAL vs 0.0% ALA; complications 1.4% MAL vs 1.7% ALA.

result.other_findings: Comparative outcome study of two photosensitisers; mean Vancouver Scar Scores 3.1 (MAL) and 3.9 (ALA).

result.topic: Suspected testicular cancer referral pathway timeliness
result.setting: BAUS EMPAST national audit across 107 UK centres
result.standard: NHS Faster Diagnosis Standard (28-day proxy) and 14-day consultation standard

cycle1.dates: Referred cohort June–July 2025; orchidectomy cohort April 2023–March 2024
cycle1.result: Median referral-to-consultation 7.5 days (IQR 5–14), 79% seen within 14 days; median referral-to-outcome communication 14 days (IQR 8–25), 81% achieved FDS proxy; median referral-to-orchidectomy 23 days (IQR 15–35).

result.other_findings: Pre-referral ultrasound in 18.6% of cases, associated with more cancer diagnoses (60% vs 9.7%) and higher FDS proxy achievement (OR 1.10, 95% CI 1.06–1.84, p < 0.01).

result.topic: Dual antiplatelet therapy on discharge after CABG
result.setting: Essex Cardiothoracic Centre, Basildon; emergency coronary artery bypass grafting
result.standard: EACTS guidelines: 1-year dual antiplatelet therapy on discharge after emergency CABG

cycle1.result: 82.14% discharged on appropriate dual antiplatelet therapy; 100% had one antiplatelet prescribed.

result.intervention: Departmental education for resident doctors, posters in the doctors' office, and a registrar counter-check of antiplatelet medication on the day of discharge.

cycle2.result: 100% discharged on appropriate dual antiplatelet therapy.

result.other_findings: not reported

result.setting: Clontarf Hospital, Dublin; rehabilitation hospital for older adults
result.standard: Intentional rounding KPI of 90% compliance with the IR check-list

cycle1.result: 2 wards achieved the KPI (90%); others fell short mainly due to incomplete check-lists on night-duty shifts.

result.other_findings: 5 randomly selected check-lists audited per ward; patient feedback was very positive. Further support and education needed for night-duty shifts.

result.topic: Pelvic ultrasound for endometrial cancer in women with visible haematuria
result.setting: Haematuria clinic, Ashford and St Peter's Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust
result.standard: NICE: direct access pelvic ultrasound for women aged 55 or over with visible haematuria and/or abnormal cancer risk markers

cycle1.result: Compliance with NICE guidance 1/17 (5.8%).

result.other_findings: Three patients (1.3%) had endometrial cancer; flexible cystoscopy was normal in all and CT urography missed one. Poor adherence attributed to limited awareness in the flexible cystoscopy team.

result.topic: Peri-operative cardiac arrest in vascular surgery
result.setting: 7th National Audit Project (NAP7) of the Royal College of Anaesthetists, UK case registry
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: 69 peri-operative cardiac arrests in vascular surgery, estimated incidence 1 in 670 vascular anaesthetics (95%CI 1 in 520–830); 48 (70%) had died at time of reporting.

result.other_findings: Most arrests (83%) occurred during non-elective surgery; commonest cause was major haemorrhage (39, 57%); 41% presented with ruptured AAA.

result.setting: Multidisciplinary inpatient stroke unit
result.standard: Australian guideline recommendations for stroke rehabilitation; minimum target of 10% change per practice area

cycle1.result: Baseline compliance across 27 targeted practice areas (figures not reported in abstract).

result.intervention: Four cycles of audit feedback plus education and training for staff.

cycle2.result: 20 of 27 targeted areas (74%) met or exceeded the 10% change target; sensation screening +75%, rehabilitation +100%, neglect screening +92%, assessment 100%.

result.other_findings: Four audits between 2009 and 2013. Anxiety and depression screening fell (−27%) and patient education about stroke changed little (6%).

result.topic: Paediatric forearm fracture management in the emergency department
result.setting: Emergency department, Whittington Hospital, London
result.standard: BOAST: early closed reduction by manipulation for most forearm fractures, documented neurovascular assessment and formal consent

cycle1.result: 62.5% manipulated in ED; 44.4% (4/9) of those not manipulated could have been; 67% (16/24) needed a procedure under GA; neurovascular assessment documented in 29%; formal consent for manipulation 0%.

result.intervention: Planned: hospital protocol being produced to standardise care.
result.other_findings: 47% (7/15) of those manipulated in ED were unsuitable to continue non-operative treatment.

result.setting: Golden Jubilee National Hospital, Glasgow; standard lobectomies
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: Low-risk RATS patients had a 2-day reduction in median LOS versus open (4.0 vs 6.0 days, P=0.0445); no LOS benefit in high-risk patients (5.5d both, P=0.2407); 30-day CV events not different (P=0.6423).

result.intervention: Recommendations endorsed at unit CME (Nov 2025) for scheduling low-risk patients for RATS; re-audit planned with 2026 data.
result.other_findings: Low-risk patients made up 57% of volume (178/346).

result.setting: Three geriatric medicine wards, Our Lady of Lourdes Hospital, Drogheda
result.standard: Local HSE guidelines: formalised delirium screening tool within 24 hours of ED presentation for all adults over 65

cycle1.result: 21.4% (n = 12) had a delirium screening tool documented, all using 4AT and all completed by the OPAL/ED Frailty Intervention Team.

result.other_findings: 25% (n = 14) were diagnosed with delirium later in admission, of whom only 3 had been screened; terms such as 'confusion' and 'agitated' were often used instead of delirium.

result.setting: District general hospital, Sandwell and West Birmingham Hospitals NHS Trust
result.standard: Best-practice standards: Tokyo Grade II/III indication >90%; decision within 48 hours >80%; tubogram completion >80%

cycle1.result: Tokyo Grade II/III indication 56%; decision within 48 hours 52%; antibiotics 100%; post-procedure documentation 96%; tubogram 40%; definitive plan within 8 weeks 80%.

result.intervention: Planned: standardised cholecystostomy pathway to be introduced in early 2026, with re-audit one year later.
result.other_findings: Only 22% ultimately underwent laparoscopic cholecystectomy; many managed with long-term drains.

result.setting: 8 Manchester University NHS Foundation Trust hospitals
result.standard: 2021 joint European guidelines on gallbladder polyp surveillance

cycle1.result: 17% of patient pathways adhered to the guidelines; 14% adherent for patients with risk factors; 58 unnecessary scans and 35 missed cholecystectomy referrals.

result.intervention: Recommended: single guideline distribution, inclusion of unacknowledged size thresholds and a standardised radiology reporting template.
result.other_findings: 63% of ultrasound reports did not document gallstones, 35% did not document wall thickness and 0% documented polyp sessility.

result.setting: District general hospital endoscopy unit, University Hospitals of Morecambe Bay NHS Trust, Lancaster
result.standard: BSG standards (rectal diclofenac prophylaxis); published PEP incidence benchmark 3–8%

cycle1.result: PEP in 9/157 (5.7%); rectal diclofenac compliance ≈99%; pre-ERCP amylase documented in 6.3%; pre-operative IV fluids 29%; post-operative IV fluids 41.4%.

result.other_findings: Severe PEP in 1/9 (11%) with one ITU admission and one procedure-related death; younger age and female sex were risk factors.

result.topic: Delirium recognition after hip fracture surgery
result.setting: Single centre, Nottingham University Hospitals NHS Trust
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: Delirium diagnosed in 10 of 150 (6.7%); physiotherapists documented features suggestive of delirium before medical diagnosis in 28 patients; median time to medical diagnosis 16.5 hours (IQR 1.2–32); no documented 4AT use.

result.intervention: Multidisciplinary education session and a standardised delirium documentation sticker with 4AT, PINCHME checklist, management prompt and mandatory yes/no delirium tick box.
result.other_findings: Post-intervention outcomes to be reported; physiotherapists did not use the term delirium.

result.setting: Elective and trauma orthopaedic wards, University College London Hospitals
result.standard: National standards for discharge summary content (inclusion of diagnostic imaging)

cycle1.result: 0 of 114 elective discharge summaries (0%) documented imaging results.

result.intervention: Educational poster on findings and national standards and a structured discharge template with a mandatory 'diagnostic imaging' section.
result.other_findings: Parallel trauma audit: 16 of 80 (20%) documented imaging; trauma template being introduced with re-audit underway.

result.setting: Frimley Park Hospital and Wexham Park Hospital
result.standard: GIRFT and Royal College of Surgeons post-operative documentation standards

cycle1.result: Antibiotics 87% FPH / 68% WPH; VTE 80% / 55%; diet 94% / 90%; recovery location 7% / 10%; observation frequency 4% / 7%; suture removal 22% / 16%.

result.intervention: Recommended: standardised post-operative proforma and trainee education.
result.other_findings: Includes adult and paediatric cases; key shortfalls were post-operative monitoring and suture removal.

result.topic: Timing of cholecystectomy in gallstone pancreatitis
result.setting: University Hospital Monklands, NHS Lanarkshire
result.standard: National guidelines: cholecystectomy during index admission or within two weeks of discharge

cycle1.result: 30 (50.8%) operated; 9 (15.2%) timely; mean delay 11.2 weeks; 19 (32%) readmitted, 10 with recurrent GIP.

result.intervention: Expedited cholecystectomy pathway and live tracker.

cycle2.result: 15 operated (50%); 13 (43%) timely, 12 during index admission and 1 within 2 weeks of discharge.

result.other_findings: Root causes were lack of structured follow-up, delays in anaesthetic clearance and limited theatre availability.

result.setting: Inpatient psychiatric wards, East Suffolk
result.standard: BNF and Maudsley Prescribing Guidelines antipsychotic dosage; HDAT monitoring form for each patient on HDAT

cycle1.result: 166 (64.6%) on antipsychotics; 2 (1.2%) discharged on HDAT, of whom one did not have the monitoring form completed.

result.other_findings: HDAT prescribing was less prevalent than assumed.

result.setting: West Suffolk Hospital NHS Trust and Wye Valley NHS Trust
result.standard: Follow-up protocols: colorectal MDT referral for neoplastic appendix histology

cycle1.result: Acute appendicitis confirmed in 279 (91.5%); 7 (2.3%) neoplastic findings; all NET and adenocarcinoma cases referred to colorectal MDT.

result.other_findings: 15 (4.9%) negative for appendicitis; supports routine histology of all appendicectomy specimens.

result.setting: GP practice (Bridge View Medical Group, Sunderland); patients discharged to primary care after bariatric surgery
result.standard: BOMSS annual nutritional monitoring (five blood tests), 80% standard; mean BMI reduction audit standard 20%

cycle1.result: Mean BMI reduction 23.07% (standard 20%); 14.29% had all five recommended annual blood tests; FBC 63.74% highest, 25-hydroxyvitamin D 25.27% lowest.

result.other_findings: 10-patient sub-sample had 32.85% mean BMI reduction within 2 years; BMI rose after discharge from Tier 4. Monitoring was not commissioned or resourced.

result.topic: Iron deficiency anaemia investigation in heart failure
result.setting: Hospital inpatients admitted with heart failure, Wexham Park Hospital, Frimley Health NHS Foundation Trust
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: 138 (63.3%) anaemic; only 40 of 138 (29%) had a full haematinic screen; 49 (56.3%) of those with iron studies were iron deficient, of whom only 12 (24.5%) were prescribed oral iron.

result.other_findings: Staff survey: only 19.7% could correctly define anaemia and 9.1% were aware of IDA treatment guidelines.

result.setting: Elective surgical inpatients, St Vincent's University Hospital, Dublin
result.standard: SVUH Antimicrobial Guidelines recommended surgical prophylaxis regimens and duration

cycle1.result: 64 (79%) compliant with prophylaxis duration; 17 (21%) not compliant.

result.intervention: Targeted smartphone application introduced to improve access to prophylaxis guidelines.
result.other_findings: Compliance improved compared with prior audits; 9 (53%) of extended courses had no documented reason.

result.setting: Department of General Surgery, Midlands Regional Hospital Tullamore
result.standard: Royal College of Surgeons (England) documentation guidelines

cycle1.result: Vital signs documented in less than 46%, medications 43%, allergies 72%; smoking and alcohol under 40%.

result.intervention: Standardised structured surgical admission proforma replacing freehand notes.

cycle2.result: 100% proforma uptake; vital signs documentation improved by a mean 60.0%; medications +46.9%, alcohol +43.1%, smoking +40.6%, laboratory results +17.5%; 96.1% had identifiable registration numbers.

result.other_findings: Legibility and efficiency of documentation also improved.

result.topic: Swallow screen within 4 hours of stroke
result.setting: Level 3 stroke ward, Our Lady of Lourdes Hospital, Drogheda
result.standard: HSE National Guideline for Swallow Screening 2017: swallow screen within 4 hours of diagnosis

cycle1.result: 24 of 29 had a documented swallow assessment; only 3 were screened within 4 hours of diagnosis.

result.intervention: Planned: teaching sessions and reminder charts for on-call NCHDs and nursing staff.
result.other_findings: not reported

result.setting: Adult acute psychiatric inpatient ward, Macclesfield
result.standard: Lester Tool cardiometabolic screening and intervention

cycle1.result: None compliant with all parameters; smoking documented 100% (78% given intervention); lifestyle/diet 7%; BMI 80% (no interventions); blood pressure 90%; blood glucose 40%; lipids 57% (no interventions).

result.intervention: Recommended: regular staff training and education.
result.other_findings: Interventions for abnormal BMI and lipids were absent.

result.topic: Perioperative care in breast free flap reconstruction
result.setting: Royal Free Hospital, London; microvascular breast free flap reconstruction
result.standard: ABS and BAPRAS guidelines; length of stay target under 3 days

cycle1.result: 22 flaps; average LOS 5.47 days (target <3d); no unplanned readmissions; 18% return to theatre; 18% total complication rate.

result.intervention: Planned: evidence-based modified ERAS protocol via MDT collaboration.
result.other_findings: Three-year review of 323 flaps showed 13% return to theatre and no unplanned readmissions.

result.setting: District hospital (Yeovil District Hospital, Somerset Foundation Trust)
result.standard: GIRFT (June 2022) guidance on paediatric appendicitis; national negative appendicectomy average 10%; 48-hour antibiotic guideline for complex cases

cycle1.result: Negative appendicectomy rate 22%; median time to surgery 23 hours; pre-operative antibiotics 81%; complication rate 18%.

cycle2.result: Negative appendicectomy rate 4%; median time to surgery 19.25 hours; pre-operative antibiotics 85%; complication rate 6%.

result.other_findings: Unnecessary post-operative antibiotics in 35% of simple cases; only 86% of complex cases met the 48-hour guideline.

result.topic: Timing of postoperative LMWH in spinal surgery
result.setting: Royal National Orthopaedic Hospital, tertiary orthopaedic centre
result.standard: Local guidelines on postoperative LMWH timing

cycle1.result: LMWH given within correct timeframe in 22 (81.5%); 5 (18.5%) delayed.

result.intervention: Planned: standardised postoperative documentation, strengthened handover, staff education and electronic prompts; re-audit planned.
result.other_findings: Delays linked to inconsistent documentation and handover gaps.

result.setting: Enhanced Team West, general adult psychiatry
result.standard: Local trust prescribing guidelines for clonazepam

cycle1.result: Appropriate indication 94%; consultant oversight 88%; unlicensed medicine form 6%; weekly review 100%; discontinuation plan before discharge 47%.

result.intervention: Recommended: training on unlicensed medicine documentation and reinforced discharge planning.
result.other_findings: Among those continued after discharge, 89% had documented dose-reduction attempts in the community.

result.setting: University Hospitals Coventry and Warwickshire, UK tertiary centre
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: 214 operated with curative intent; mortality 1.40% at 3 months and 2.34% at 1 year; recurrence 10.75% among operated patients; 88 managed non-operatively, 16 with complete response.

result.other_findings: Minimally invasive approaches predominated (174 robotic, 28 TAMIS); 100 cases excluded for incomplete documentation.

result.setting: Acute rehabilitation hospital (Royal Hospital Donnybrook, Dublin); patients over 65
result.standard: NICE guidelines on indications for PPI use

cycle1.result: 43% on a PPI; 83.4% of these had no indication; 77.7% on therapeutic dose without indication; 100% on PPI longer than 6 weeks.

result.intervention: Education to hospital doctors on NICE PPI prescribing guidelines.

cycle2.result: 60.4% on a PPI; 55% had no indication; 83% on PPI longer than 6 weeks; 56.5% on inappropriate dose.

result.other_findings: Authors report inappropriate prescribing fell by 28.4% and accurate dosing improved by 21.2%.

result.setting: Single centre, Barts NHS Trust, London; referrals to plastics for autologous breast reconstruction
result.standard: Oncoplastic guidelines; essential referral data items (immediate/delayed, BMI, smoking, neoadjuvant and adjuvant treatment)

cycle1.result: Immediate/delayed status 18 (94.7%); neoadjuvant chemotherapy 13 (68.4%); adjuvant plans 15 (78.9%); comorbidities 6 (31.6%); BMI 2 (10.5%); smoking 4 (21.1%).

result.intervention: Standardised referral proforma as an online tick-box form sent to a shared plastics email.
result.other_findings: Proforma reported as widely adopted, but no re-audit data given.

result.setting: Irish Hip Fracture Database; all 16 eligible hospitals in the Republic of Ireland
result.standard: not reported

cycle1.result: Coverage 81%; mean LOS 20 days, median 13 days; 39% reviewed by a geriatrician at any time, 15% pre-operatively; 30% discharged directly home.

result.other_findings: Preliminary 2016 coverage 86.5%; recommendations include direct transfer to the trauma operating hospital and local hip fracture working groups.

result.setting: Mater Misericordiae University Hospital, Dublin; inpatient falls with serious injury
result.standard: HSE Service User Falls guide; British Society guideline Medicines and Falls in Hospital; STOPP/START; NICE Falls in Older People 2013

cycle1.result: Medication review carried out after the fall in 9.09% (3); 84.85% had polypharmacy; no falls-risk medications stopped or dose changed.

result.other_findings: Post-fall reviews mainly by interns (48.49%) and SHOs (39.39%); 51.52% on antihypertensives and 24.24% on sedatives.

result.setting: Department of Spinal Surgery, James Cook University Hospital, Middlesbrough; adolescent idiopathic scoliosis
result.standard: Local AIS post-operative care guidelines (25 domains), target 100% compliance

cycle1.result: 100% compliance in 12/25 domains (2015); several domains at 20-70% compliance.

cycle2.result: 100% compliance in 21/25 domains; of the rest, 2 reached 93.33% and 2 reached 80%.

result.other_findings: Remaining shortfalls due to patients declining antiemetic/analgesic medication or incomplete documentation by staff unfamiliar with the checklist.

result.setting: 14 wards and Emergency Department, University Hospital Limerick; medical admissions
result.standard: UHL DNACPR policy

cycle1.result: 62/72 (86%) signed by an NCHD, 26/72 (36%) by a consultant, 8/72 (11%) by a nurse; 46/72 (63.8%) signed only by an NCHD, 11 of which had no documented discussion.

result.intervention: Recommended: training on appropriate DNACPR form use for NCHDs, nurses and consultants.
result.other_findings: 75/247 (23.1%) medically admitted patients had a DNACPR form; 3 were from previous admissions.

result.setting: Watford General Hospital; emergency surgical admissions
result.standard: Local microbiology guidelines for antibiotic treatment of acute cholecystitis

cycle1.result: Compliance 12.8%.

result.intervention: Results disseminated, educational material produced and antibiotic 'champions' appointed.
result.other_findings: Patient demographics, fever, inflammatory markers and liver function did not predict non-compliant prescribing.
